script_hooks.logic:

Let globalRegister be the register of parent.
Call helper with (this state).
If condition flag "meteor_done" is up this frame, then
  Call helper2 with (parent).
  Call helper3 with (this state).
If not call helper4 with (this state) and the enemy is ready to act, then
  Set globalRegister's 'execAbilityId' to nothing.
  Let v be call helper5 with (this state).
  If the id of the move labelled list on the enemy does not contain v, then set globalRegister's 'execAbilityId' to v.
  The enemy uses v.
